comparison.objective: Place three personal devices on matching charging interfaces; candidate performs physical size-selective separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Device-specific placement, magnetic alignment, and strap handling versus bimanual lifting and controlled agitation of a loaded perforated screen.
comparison.success_condition: Released charging with visible feedback for five seconds and limited stand motion versus ≥98% media recovery with all washers retained and the screen reseated.
comparison.reason: Both require stable released endpoints, but functional charging alignment does not test loose-body separation. Missing rubric details: none material.
